title: Co-founder breakup
prompt: My cofounder and I are splitting badly. I need something that says he can't use our customer list or code. I'm scared he'll launch a copycat this month.

title: Family loan

risk_notes: Secured interest likely omitted by user

title: Harassment-adjacent workplace

title: Creator burned by brand

risk_notes: User wants backward damages — scope discipline

title: Vendor ransomware scare
